content.title: Dunkin' Donuts Is Offering 1 Million Free Coffees Again: Here's How to Get Yours
content.text: Credit : Ron Antonelli/Bloomberg via Getty NEED TO KNOW Dunkin' is giving away one million free coffees on April 21Guests can get a Free Coffee Certificate using the promo code “FREECOFFEE1” starting at 9 a.m. local timeThe announcement was teased through a Notes app screenshot on the chain's Instagram, which also hinted at summer menu updates Dunkin' Donuts is about to make a million people's day. The chain confirmed to PEOPLE that it is handing out one million free coffees on April 21 after sharing the deal's promo code and clues for its summer menu in a cryptic social media post on Friday, April 17. The brand shared a screenshot of a Notes app on its Instagram with text above that said, “just a girl and her notes app One note had the subject line, “Another million coffees? April 21st?,” and a note following that said, “drop @ 9am code could be freecoffee1.” “Just gonna leave this here,” the brand wrote in its caption. As it turns out, the casual Notes app drop had deeper implications. “On April 21, Dunkin' is serving up one million free coffees after accidentally leaking both the promo code and a few Easter eggs on the summer menu on social media,” the brand said in a statement shared with PEOPLE. Starting at 9 a.m. local time on April 21, a million guests can get a free coffee using the promo code “FREECOFFEE1.” The Free Coffee Certificate is valid for seven days after the promo code entry, and the deal is limited to one per customer while supplies last. The deal does not include Cold Brew or Extra-Large Hot Coffee orders. Dunkin' Donuts announced on Instagram that they are giving away a million free coffees on April 21. Patrick T. Fallon/Bloomberg/Getty Menu hints could also be found in the Notes screenshot. One note remarked, “Things I miss. oreo coolatta,” referencing the Oreo-flavored frozen beverage the chain featured on its menu in 2015 and potentially indicating its return for the chain's summer menu. Another note said “Work to do. Make content for new spring menu next week,” seemingly hinting at another spring menu. The chain already released a banana-focused spring menu on March 4. In a release shared with PEOPLE, the chain declared banana “the flavor of the season.” It announced banana syrup and cold foam, which fans can add to espresso drinks, iced coffee, matcha and Refreshers. Related Stories The menu came with new drinks like a Banana Puddin' Cloud Latte, Banana Daydream Refresher and Bananarama Matcha. The chain also launched a zero-sugar energy drink called Dunkin' Zero. The free coffee announcement follows the chain giving away 1,000,001 free hot or iced coffees on April Fools' Day. After giving away a million coffees to celebrate the unofficial holiday in 2025, the chain decided to outdo itself. “Remember last April Fools' when Dunkin' gave away a million free coffees and people thought it was a prank? Well, this year, Dunkin' is going even bolder!” said a release the company shared with PEOPLE.
